deviations_from_card: Probe re-run at HEAD with the stage block: 87 findings (card: 81) - the avatar-renderer work added Avatar.tsx (6 react-hooks/refs, latest-ref pattern) and renderers.golden.test.ts (3 as-unknown-as + 1 JSON.parse). Fixed all 30 hygiene findings: 17 as-unknown-as (not 10; the feat commit message says 13, which is wrong - 5 production, 12 test), 5 JSON.parse, 1 keydown, 1 exhaustive-deps, 1 unused var. Baselined only the six compiler-class rules the card names: 57 findings in apps/stage/eslint-suppressions.json (refs 50 incl. Avatar.tsx 6, set-state-in-effect 2, preserve-manual-memoization 2, use-memo 1, immutability 1, purity 1). Coupled files outside write_set: apps/stage/src/avatar/renderers.golden.test.ts (new since card; golden hash still green), apps/stage/src/test-json.ts (new: the single test JSON helper the card allows, named in STAGE_DOORS), apps/stage/scripts/lint-gate.test.mjs (acceptance tests, wired into the stage lint script), scripts/ci-lanes.test.mjs + README.md (lane denominator 20 -> 21, per slot A). Keydown 'fold': App keeps its handler (same body, same deps via useCallback) and attaches it through usePlaybackKeys exported from Controls.tsx, with the same enable condition (!broadcast && !live), rather than moving logic into the Controls component (which renders only when loaded, which would have changed behaviour). Production casts became checked single casts (WebSocket as SocketLike, createBufferSource() as SourceLike) and a declare-global Window {__stage, __stageOverflow}; zero runtime change. ESLint does not apply suppressions to stdin, so ratchet cases lint a seeded copy at src/__lint_gate__.tsx (deleted in after()).
notes: Red-before: the gate test run with STAGE_LINT_CONFIG=<HEAD eslint.config.js> -> 0 of 7 pass. Stage lint now takes ~20 s (eslint + 7 seeded eslint runs). Uncommitted sibling Rust work (crates/shadowrunr-brain, -daemon, -sim) present in tree, not touched.
